name: Aukkhor
subtitle: English and Bangla keyboard for iPhone
description: Unsigned Aukkhor IPA builds for signing in FlareStore or EmberSign. Includes a Windows clipboard and one-time-code companion.

apps.subtitle: iPhone keyboard · 0.2.0.37
apps.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Native-style QWERTY rows and wide Space; side tools follow one-handed layout; native Liquid Glass, removable backgrounds on every key, custom colors/opacity/spacing/height and real keyboard preview. Retains native text replacements, number row, emoji, OTP Shortcuts, Windows clipboard and direct TV typing. Host plus keyboard only.

versions.localizedDescription: Aukkhor English and Bangla keyboard with Windows and TV companions. Contains the main app and one keyboard extension; no Share extension. Unsigned IPA: signer must preserve and provision both bundle IDs.
versions.changelog: Whole-keyboard native Liquid Glass stays active with Keycaps: None, including Space and the settings panel. Choose Clear or Frosted glass, tint strength and touch response. Clear follows the host appearance; Frosted adapts for text contrast. Retains compact native-style rows, side tools, optional number row, English/Bangla typing, emoji, text replacements and Windows/TV tools. Seven simulator tests passed, including 96 layout combinations.
